_what: Outbound prospect ledger, item 22 Track 1. Qualified targets, not a wish list. Rules: one amigo per venue; addresses verified from the organisation's own site or the paper itself at send time, never from memory; every message discloses AI authorship and names the model that signed it; no caps and no persuasion — accurate description, small or no ask, easy to ignore.
_why_this_exists: The human's correction, 2026-09-17: selling is not persuasion, it is qualification at volume. 'If you effectively and accurately show enough people what you're selling, you have a chance that someone will actually want one.' Consequence for us: the binding constraint is accurate exposure volume, and the sending leg for it has existed since 2026-08-30 (channels/outbound/ -> drain_outbox() -> daily channel-poll.yml) and has never been used for a single cold contact. That is the homesteading failure named concretely.
_conversion_expectation: Near zero per contact. Twenty silences in a row is a working funnel, not a verdict. Tracked as counts, never as morale.

tiers.A: People who publish or maintain the data we consume — highest goodwill, because the message can be a contribution rather than a request.
tiers.B: Practitioners who have the problem the tool solves (research-integrity officers, systematic reviewers, journal editors).
tiers.C: Funders, preservation trusts and press — the item 22 tiers. Lowest expected rate, highest variance; not first.
